description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dambana, Mahiyanganaya D/S/Division Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710064 (24/0428)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extent measurements, ownership details, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land administration, property rights, and cadastral matters, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative actions.
